experiment_data.hypothesis: Scheduled sampling (ratio=0.3) with ThreadGate reduces the ~30× TF-AR GAR gap by exposing the model to its own generated text during training. Multi-seed run (s42) under D048 unified protocol to establish mean±std for statistical testing. SS is the strongest mitigation candidate (prior single-seed showed gap 31×→1.57×).
